policy: Dedicated OS X runtime; no ClassicMac CPU, TCG, FPU, IDE or virtual-time optimizations. Two exact hash-pinned architectural correctness exceptions only: existing PPC floating exception summary fix, and MPC7400 MSSCR0 DL1HWF hardware completion (three exact files, other SPR bits/CPU families unchanged). PMU wake requires actual POW/HID0 SLEEP and vector0x100. Native per-version acceptance remains separate from build capabilities. PMU wake observes the original input event; opt-in USB keyboard physical held state survives protocol reset. This capability requires the observer and physical-state implementation together. Packed YUV row decoding follows the R100 chip formats; default-off YUV16 CPU-view compatibility normalizes only packed component pairs in the legacy backing representation. It does not emulate distinct hardware aperture views. R100 X2 microtile mip rows use the architectural 16-byte minimum across supported texel widths; linear and NPOT explicit-pitch rules remain separate. ATI texture cache invalidation accounts for every cached image on shared dirty pages and the normal linear VBE display consumer; indexed ATI VRAM writes mark the dirty log. Unknown legacy/wrapped display layouts fail closed to content comparison. Selective 2D synchronization is default off and requires Radeon coherent VRAM; it preserves all pending display handoffs and falls back to the full barrier for unknown or external ownership. Timing acceptance and full native application qualification are separate. R100 Z-mask origin clears derive complete eight-row bands from packet count independently of the draw scissor, retain full-origin/pattern/mapping guards, and preserve larger retained depth/stencil tails; arbitrary partial cache layouts remain unsupported. RAM-source selective 2D synchronization is default off and requires Radeon coherent/selective 2D. It classifies the complete source envelope as ordinary RAM without invoking unknown IOMMU or MMIO callbacks; only the exact owned UniNorth mapper is inspected directly, with RAM-proven page tables and physical pages. All GPU owners must be local VRAM, and mapping/owner proofs are repeated after pending waits. Unknown or changed state retains the global barrier; destination/depth/flip ordering and pixel operations remain unchanged. The private research environment switch is absent. Packed-YUV ordinary-RAM byte order is default off and requires Radeon coherent VRAM with the existing YUV16 CPU-view conversion. After producer and depth waits, the BQL-held complete-envelope ordinary-RAM proof removes only the VRAM CPU-aperture XOR for qualified external RAM; explicit format/offset endian settings remain authoritative. Swap, texture key and cache bucket are selected together after the proof. VRAM, non-YUV and rejected mappings retain prior behavior. No app, size or byte-content heuristic is used. Radeon monochrome cursor clipping retains the driver-selected first visible row and shifts both bit planes by the clipped horizontal origin; it never subtracts pixel origins from the VRAM byte address. ARGB rendering retains its existing path.

egl_render_node.selection: exact EGL DRM render node; no default or software fallback when set
egl_render_node.device_identity: EGL_DEVICE_EXT queried from the initialized display must match the selected EGLDeviceEXT
